fact: Eswatini launched the She Powers Africa Digital Academy, which begins with 50 women from government and government-related institutions trained in AI, cybersecurity, data science, software development and IT operations, delivered by the UAE's General Women's Union with TDRA and the Digital Government Academy.
Eswatini Positive News reports the Ministry of ICT is training Change Agents from various government ministries to lead implementation of the Eswatini Digital Project.
